title: Singer and Songwriter PENNY X releases a wonderful new single "Faster"
htmlContent:
PENNY X, an independent singer-songwriter from Berlin, Germany recently released a wonderful single called "Faster," a record that’s enjoyable for every single second on the new smash of a record.

PENNY X’s “Faster” is that more that music can possesses. She takes advantage of having the listener’s ear to give them more than they came with, as she gives a message that makes you feel like you’re enough that resonates now more than ever. If you love good music it’s nothing not to love about this major record, but if you love music with substance you’ll carry this song with you for time to come.
